arguments.Title: 주행 측정 참조 확인
arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { result.Log("client="+Object.FindFirstObjectByType<UnityAutonomousClient>()+" vehicle="+Object.FindFirstObjectByType<VehicleController>()+" hud="+Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>()); foreach(var b in Object.FindObjectsByType<MonoBehaviour>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) if(b is IAutonomousVehicle) result.Log("vehicleType="+b.GetType().FullName+" name="+b.name); foreach(var cam in Object.FindObjectsByType<Camera>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) result.Log("camera="+cam.name+" enabled="+cam.enabled); } }
